title: Grandia: Digital Museum
native_title: グランディア ～デジタル・ミュージアム～
overview: Grandia: Digital Museum is a fan disc containing production materials and bonus content for the game Grandia. It is presented as a museum which the characters are visiting, and there is a dungeon which the player can explore to fight monsters and unlock additional materials for viewing in the museum portion. In addition to a gallery of production artwork, there is also a radio drama with a new scenario not in the main game, a bestiary, and a selection of save files which can be used in the main game to replay the game's most famous moments.
